subject: Data Engineering
title: The Future of Scale
description: A quick, practical guide to The Future of Scale.

hook.text: Data volumes will keep growing. But the tools to process them keep getting simpler and cheaper.

buildup.text: Serverless query engines, auto-scaling clusters, and embedded databases lower the barrier every year.

discovery.text: The trend is clear: the same power that once required a Hadoop cluster now fits on a laptop.

twist.text: AI-generated data may explode volumes even further — synthetic data, embeddings, and model outputs.

climax.text: The future isn't about bigger tools. It's about smarter tools that handle scale invisibly.

quiz.question: What is the trend in big data tooling?
options: Tools are getting simpler while handling more data
